title: Everyday Phrases — Asking an AI Assistant
scene_zh: 詢問AI助手 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hey, are you there this morning?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🤖 實用詢問AI助手必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Asking an AI Assistant
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用詢問AI助手情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從清晨問天氣日程、請AI寫信翻譯總結，到追問修改、設提醒控家電道晚安，400句一次聽齊。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Asking an AI Assistant phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From checking weather and schedule, to asking the AI to write, translate, summarize, revise, set reminders, and control smart home devices. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, are you there this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am here and ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is it right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is six thirty on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 現在是週一早上六點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I sleep through my alarm?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是睡過頭沒聽到鬧鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I woke you gently.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過我很溫柔地把您叫醒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the weather today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cool with some clouds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rain comes after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the temperature outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about fifteen degrees.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it get warmer later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, up to twenty by noon.
dialogue.zh: 會，到中午能升到二十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear my warm jacket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jacket is a smart choice.
dialogue.zh: 穿外套是個聰明的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any wind in the forecast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light wind, nothing strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sun coming out at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə sʌn ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt æt ɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, after three in the afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 能，下午三點後就出太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on my schedule today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天的日程有什麼安排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your first meeting is at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that meeting held?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the small room upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else is coming along?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anna and the sales team.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have time for coffee first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv taɪm fɔr ˈkɔfi fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you have one hour free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else before lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick call at eleven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remind me about that call.
dialogue.zh: 到時候提醒我那通電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ping you at ten fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pɪŋ ju æt tɛn ˈfɪfti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about my afternoon plans?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours of quiet desk work.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時安靜的案頭工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my brother text me?
dialogue.zh: 我哥哥給我發訊息了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two messages last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the first one to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asks about Sunday dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any urgent emails waiting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One from your boss, marked high.
dialogue.zh: 有一封老闆來的，標了高優先級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me a short news update.
dialogue.zh: 給我來個簡短的新聞速覽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here are three quick headlines.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it simple, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The city opened a new park.
dialogue.zh: 本市新開放了一座公園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the second story?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food prices fell at the market.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that good news for us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your coffee costs less now.
dialogue.zh: 算，您的咖啡現在更便宜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the last headline?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big storm hits the coast.
dialogue.zh: 一場大風暴襲擊了海岸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that storm affect me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you live far away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything fun about sports?
dialogue.zh: 體育方面有什麼趣事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The team won a close game.
dialogue.zh: 球隊贏了一場焦灼的比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is traffic this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The road near town is slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I leave a bit earlier?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, go out by eight fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a faster route?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The river road saves ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 沿河那條路能省十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any accidents on the highway?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No crashes, just lots of cars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What breakfast fits my busy day?
dialogue.zh: 早餐吃什麼應付我忙碌的一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oats and fruit are quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have eggs and some bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then toast makes a fine start.
dialogue.zh: 那烤片吐司開場就很不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have time to sit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit down and enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play some light music please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a gentle playlist.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This music feels really nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps you start slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shoes match this outfit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brown ones look great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I pack my laptop?
dialogue.zh: 我筆記型電腦裝進包了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You left it by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will grab it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty of time, no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing before I go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what is it this time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add laundry to my evening list.
dialogue.zh: 把洗衣服加進我晚間待辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it waits after five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it rain while I walk home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt reɪn waɪl aɪ wɔk hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我走回家那會兒會下雨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the rain ends by four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad I asked, good to know.
dialogue.zh: 好在問了一聲，心裡有數了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light coat is still wise.
dialogue.zh: 不過帶件薄外套更穩妥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did I sleep last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You slept seven solid hours.
dialogue.zh: 您結結實實睡了七小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That beats Friday, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday gave you only five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Track my sleep every night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, with morning reports.
dialogue.zh: 會的，每天早上給您報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick a gentle wake-up song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft piano works, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but nothing too loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, quiet piano tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look ready to go?
dialogue.zh: 我看起來準備好出門了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound very ready today.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來您今天萬事俱備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the smooth morning.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你讓我早上這麼順當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, enjoy your day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Help me answer my boss's email.
dialogue.zh: 幫我回一封老闆的郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, tell me what to send.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔv kɔrs tɛl mi wʌt tu sɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 當然，告訴我您想發什麼內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him the report will be late.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðə rɪˈpɔrt wɪl bi leɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I give a new deadline?
dialogue.zh: 要不要給他新的截止日？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, say Wednesday at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, Wednesday noon locked in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the tone polite, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Writing it now, one moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the first line aloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dear David, I need a small favor.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪr ˈdeɪvɪd aɪ nid ə smɔl ˈfeɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 「親愛的大衛，想請您幫個小忙。」

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Favor sounds too casual here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How about a small request?
dialogue.zh: 那換成「一個小請求」怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that one fits better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next line says the report is late.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst laɪn sɛz ðə rɪˈpɔrt ɪz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下一行寫著報告會晚交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add thanks for his patience.
dialogue.zh: 再加一句感謝他的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It now ends with appreciation.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, show me the full draft.
dialogue.zh: 完美，把完整草稿給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads clean and friendly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it sound professional enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, calm and respectful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, send it right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, he will see it soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the article I saved yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 說說我昨天存的那篇文章。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The long work from home one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, can you summarize it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, in three short points.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me point one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, companies save on empty offices.
dialogue.zh: 第一，公司省下空置辦公室的開銷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what is point two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many workers report less stress.
dialogue.zh: 許多上班族說壓力變小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the article give numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, forty percent joined the study.
dialogue.zh: 有，百分之四十的人參與了研究。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds believable so far.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point three warns about lonely days.
dialogue.zh: 第三點提醒獨處會寂寞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Interesting, keep those three notes.
dialogue.zh: 有意思，這三條筆記存好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved to your reading folder.
dialogue.zh: 已放進您的閱讀資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I may ask about it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can dig deeper tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone needs Spanish travel phrases.
dialogue.zh: 我手機裡得存點西語旅行短句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know dozens, where do you go?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈdʌzənz wɛr du ju ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我會幾十句，您要去哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seville, for one week in May.
dialogue.zh: 塞維利亞，五月去玩一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us start with greetings.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I say hello there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hola, it fits any time.
dialogue.zh: 說 Hola，什麼時候都能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how do I thank people?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gracias is polite and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about asking for the bill?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You say la cuenta, my friend.
dialogue.zh: 您說那句要賬單的西語就行，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teach me one about directions.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try this, donde esta la estacion?
dialogue.zh: 試試這句：火車站在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you slow that down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, listen once more slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Repeat the station question now.
dialogue.zh: 把問車站那句再唸一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Donde esta la estacion?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My turn, how did I sound?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very close, just lift the ending.
dialogue.zh: 很接近了，句尾語調再上揚些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one more practice round.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You now sound quite natural.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What word means a tasty meal?
dialogue.zh: 哪個詞是形容飯菜好吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delicioso, like the English delicious.
dialogue.zh: 那個詞就是「美味」，跟英文的對應詞很像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for my food reviews.
dialogue.zh: 我寫餐廳評價正用得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will order like a local.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read my messages from Anna.
dialogue.zh: 唸一下安娜給我的留言。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asks about the sales numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reply that they look good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Draft ready, want to hear it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it under five words.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How about, great news today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, send that to her.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, she gets it instantly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she reply already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one heart emoji back.
dialogue.zh: 回了，傳來一個愛心表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Build a grocery list for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 幫我列今晚的採購清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any vegetables on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomatoes, spinach, and some chicken.
dialogue.zh: 番茄、菠菜，還有一點雞肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Added, do you want rice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and fresh bread too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is five items in total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the list where I can see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə lɪst wɛr aɪ kæn si ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把清單存到我看得見的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits in your notes app.
dialogue.zh: 已經放在您的備忘錄裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text my cousin about Friday dinner.
dialogue.zh: 給表妹發條關於週五聚餐的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what should it say?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I must postpone, work is crazy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a warm reason, right?
dialogue.zh: 再補一個體貼的理由，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say I got stuck at the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ aɪ ɡɑt stʌk æt ði ˈɔfəs./
dialogue.zh: 就說我被工作困在辦公室了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, want to offer another day?
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，要不要另約一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, suggest Saturday instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It now ends, Saturday instead?
dialogue.zh: 消息現在以「改週六好嗎？」收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That text feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready to fire it off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send it while I start lunch.
dialogue.zh: 趁我開吃午飯時發出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it reached your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she answer so fast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Saturday is fine for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, put it on my calendar.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，記到我的日曆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked, dinner with her at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You handle words better than me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pick them well, really.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us pause before the next task.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs pɔz bɪˈfɔr ðə nɛkst tæsk./
dialogue.zh: 下一項任務前先歇一歇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a breather, I am here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the email, quick question.
dialogue.zh: 說回郵件的事，有個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I remember it well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he reply to my apology?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one line just now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it to me, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says, no worries, Wednesday works.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫：別擔心，週三沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kinder than I feared.
dialogue.zh: 這比我擔心的客氣多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bosses can be decent too.
dialogue.zh: 老闆們有時也很通情理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make my answer sound warmer.
dialogue.zh: 把我的回覆寫得暖一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try, thanks so much, David.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, keep it professional, not chatty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, polite but brief then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the report lands by noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That detail is already inside.
dialogue.zh: 這個細節已經寫進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show it to me before it goes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ɪt tu mi bɪˈfɔr ɪt ɡoʊz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, safety first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the warm version aloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks so much, that really helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, but add one emoji.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，再加一個表情符號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A smiling face, done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That reads friendly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shall I hit send this time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, send it after my lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Queued, it goes at one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, about the article.
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，關於那篇文章。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which part feels unclear?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point two, about the stress part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want the full quote again?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, read it word for word.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Workers at home felt calmer each week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrkərz æt hoʊm fɛlt ˈkɑmər itʃ wik./
dialogue.zh: 「居家辦公的人一週比一週平靜。」

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that from the survey itself?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, line twelve of the report.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, facts matter to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I never invent numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How sure is that forty percent?
dialogue.zh: 那個百分之四十有多靠譜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The study followed only one year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the result needs caution.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tag it as tentative.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, tentative is the right word.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You think like a careful editor.
dialogue.zh: 您想問題像個細心的編輯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does appreciate even mean?
dialogue.zh: Appreciate 這個詞到底是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means you truly value someone.
dialogue.zh: 就是發自內心感激對方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So thanks a lot, but warmer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, you got the feeling.
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，您抓到語感了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Explain the word cozy too.
dialogue.zh: 再講講 Cozy 這個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cozy means warm and comfy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was my email too long?
dialogue.zh: 我那封郵件寫太長了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four short lines, just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I mention Wednesday clearly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it says noon, Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The summary sounds too long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can cut it to two points.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn kʌt ɪt tu tu pɔɪnts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, merge points two and three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Working from home eases stress but can get lonely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrkɪŋ frʌm hoʊm ˈizɪz strɛs bʌt kæn ɡɛt ˈloʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 居家辦公減壓，卻容易感到孤單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rewrite my reply to Anna.
dialogue.zh: 把回安娜那條重寫一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still about the sales numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it a little more formal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try, the figures look encouraging.
dialogue.zh: 試試「數字表現令人振奮」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, too stiff for a text.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep it light and quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually the first draft was fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I kept a copy, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us revisit the Spanish lesson.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which phrase feels shaky?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one about the station.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Donde esta la estacion, yes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the station word, is it right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈsteɪʃən wɜrd ɪz ɪt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那個表示車站的詞用對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, estacion is spot on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the word cuenta, write it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: C-u-e-n-t-a, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju i ɛn ti eɪ ðæt ɪz ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I repeat it right aloud?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly, add a soft final a.
dialogue.zh: 快對了，詞尾的 a 放輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I ask for water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Un agua, por favor, is simple.
dialogue.zh: 那句「一杯水，拜託」很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Explain por favor once more.
dialogue.zh: 再解釋一遍那個表示「請」的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means please, everywhere, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And muchas, does that mean many?
dialogue.zh: 那個詞是「很多」的意思嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, muchas gracias means thanks a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmutʃɑs ˈɡrɑsiəs minz θæŋks ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 對，整句連起來就是感激不盡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That logic helps me remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pick up patterns quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Double check my grocery list.
dialogue.zh: 再核對一遍我的採購清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomatoes, spinach, chicken, rice, bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I include fresh herbs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, want me to add basil?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, basil for the pasta.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Added, six items on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, cancel the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Removed, back to five items.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep fish as a maybe option.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted loosely, you will choose there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something else, the postponed dinner.
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，改期的那頓飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your cousin's Saturday plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add dessert after that dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet tooth approved, added.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I sign my name at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ saɪn maɪ neɪm æt ði ɛnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it closes with your name.
dialogue.zh: 是的，結尾就是您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I always forget things like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz fərˈɡɛt θɪŋz laɪk ðæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why we make a team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ wi meɪk ə tim./
dialogue.zh: 所以咱們才是一對好搭檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All fixed, my mind is calm.
dialogue.zh: 全都改好了，我心裡踏實了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, the day is going well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is five, anything left today?
dialogue.zh: 五點了，今天還有沒辦完的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your laundry is still waiting.
dialogue.zh: 您的洗衣任務還等著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remind me about laundry at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set, with a gentle buzz.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get home fastest tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt hoʊm ˈfæstɪst təˈnaɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trains run often, roads are busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let us take the train.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next one leaves at six ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst wʌn livz æt sɪks tɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Book me a seat if you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊk mi ə sit ɪf ju kæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can hold a window one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window seats are my favorite.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reserved, the ticket is in your app.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈzɜrvd ðə ˈtɪkɪt ɪz ɪn jʊər æp./
dialogue.zh: 訂好了，車票在您的應用程式裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have time to walk slowly?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv taɪm tu wɔk ˈsloʊli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty relaxed minutes.
dialogue.zh: 能，悠著走二十分鐘剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock the front door for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked, the porch light stays on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any stops on the way home?
dialogue.zh: 回家路上要停留什麼地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The market, your list is waiting.
dialogue.zh: 去趟超市，清單還等著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a timer for a quick shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ə ˈtaɪmər fɔr ə kwɪk ʃɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, starting now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am home, is the list still right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm hoʊm ɪz ðə lɪst stɪl raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我到家了，清單還準確嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five items, basil included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought the fish after all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, tonight's pasta thanks you.
dialogue.zh: 明智，今晚的麵會感謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm the bathroom towels later.
dialogue.zh: 待會兒把浴室毛巾加熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At what time, before your shower?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around nine, right before I wash.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warmed and ready by nine sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the water hot at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heater on for nine o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dim the living room lights now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lowered to a soft evening glow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little warmer in here please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat raised two degrees, better?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, this room feels cozy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cozy confirmed, the couch approves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play my calm evening playlist.
dialogue.zh: 播放我那份安靜的晚間歌單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The piano one from this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep the volume low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It plays at a quiet level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I cook with spinach?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pasta, you have everything needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read me the pasta steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boil water, add noodles, then sauce.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a cooking timer for fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Running, it rings at seven sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phone while I cook tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet mode on, chef at work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner is done, run the dishwasher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Started, it finishes by ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was my step count today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven thousand, your best this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking to the train added those.
dialogue.zh: 走去車站掙了不少步數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh air plus steps, a win.
dialogue.zh: 空氣又好步數又多，賺到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my brother reply about Sunday?
dialogue.zh: 我哥回週日聚餐的事了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says seven o'clock works fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text him yes, count me in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, family plans are locked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remind me to charge my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A reminder at nine thirty, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any updates on tomorrow's weather?
dialogue.zh: 明天的天氣有什麼新說法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunshine expected, mild and dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set tomorrow's alarm for six thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same gentle piano wake-up call?
dialogue.zh: 還是那首溫柔鋼琴曲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and skip the news briefing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, a quiet morning tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the dentist on Thursday morning.
dialogue.zh: 把看牙醫排到週四上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, want an early reminder?
dialogue.zh: 上午九點整，要提前提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the evening before at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Double reminder saved for Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add lunch with my brother too.
dialogue.zh: 週四再加上和哥哥的午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One o'clock, right after the dentist?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, he will love the surprise.
dialogue.zh: 正好，他會喜歡這個驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it a secret, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ɪt ə ˈsikrət ˈprɑmɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am getting sleepy already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then fade the screens and rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the hallway lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark now, saving a little energy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock all the windows please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every window and door is secure.
dialogue.zh: 每扇窗每扇門都安好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the room to sixteen degrees.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool and cozy, sleeping weather.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time for tea and one book chapter.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm fɔr ti ænd wʌn bʊk ˈtʃæptər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your book waits on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No screens after ten tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will dim the bedroom lights then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl dɪm ðə ˈbɛdˌrum laɪts ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那時候我把臥室燈調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play ocean sounds for sleeping.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft waves are loading now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That hum is really soothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hides the street noise too.
dialogue.zh: 它還蓋住了街上的噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are a true friend, you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ə tru frɛnd ju noʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你真是位好朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friendship is my favorite feature.
dialogue.zh: 友好正是我最得意的功能。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were great all day today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked clear questions all day.
dialogue.zh: 是您一整天問題問得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time tomorrow morning, okay?
dialogue.zh: 明天早上同一時間，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will be right here waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe more Spanish practice soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will prep ten fresh phrases.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now lights out completely.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep very well.
